description: The charge-word definition: words in an issue that name a metered or renewing charge, which admission refuses until the owner decides it. They name charges in the owner's cost definition (docs/contracts/loop-lane/README.md, "Cost, which comes to me"); a subscription login, Claude subscription usage and a measured pass run on the subscription, model usage that definition calls not cost, match none; a Claude subscription upgrade or purchase and any other vendor's subscription usage still match. Intake admission in the marketplace repository (.github/scripts/intake-triage/admit.mjs) reads it for what the issue will do: the title and the body's task items and sections under a `work_headings` heading, or the whole body when it has neither; it reads no comment. Each value is a JavaScript regular expression, matched case-insensitively. `code` is removed from the text first (closed fenced blocks, matched by whole fence lines as CommonMark defines them, and one-line inline code spans, whose opening backtick no backslash escapes), so a job or file name in code is not prose. `cost` refuses on every repository; `cost_private` refuses unless the repository's visibility reads public, since standard GitHub-hosted runner minutes are free there and larger runners are not (https://docs.github.com/en/billing/concepts/product-billing/github-actions). `work_headings` is matched against an ATX heading's text, past any leading markup, and a section runs to the next heading at its level or shallower.
cost: \b(billing|billed|spending[- ]limits?|(?<!measured pass on the )(?<!measured pass run on the )(?:(?<!claude[- ])subscriptions?|subscriptions?(?![- ]usage\b))(?![- ]log-?ins?\b)|skus?|retention|larger([- ][a-z]+){0,3}[- ]runners?|self-hosted[- ]runners?|seats?|codespaces|paid (plans?|seats?)|top[- ]?ups?|auto[- ]?(renew(al|ed|ing)?s?|reload)|extra usage)\b
work_headings: ^(?:fix|proposal|proposed fix|proposed change|proposed approach|change|changes|done when|acceptance criteria|acceptance|what to do|what to build|plan|scope|work|solution|task|tasks|deliverables?)\b
